svg.title: CSG geometry, object-owned regions, spatial material fields, and FDM vs FEM realization
svg.desc: Three-panel comparison: (a) authored CSG Box minus Cylinder with an ObjectRegion core override, object vs world coordinate frames, boundary material_transition, and spatial MaterialParameterField profile; (b) FDM structured Cartesian cells with active mask A and region indices r_i; (c) FEM single shared conforming triangulation of Omega_m subset Omega_a with airbox markers Gamma_a and local core mesh grading.
